timeframe: exact fundingRate calc timestamps plus five-minute mark-price opens
license_or_terms: Binance public-data and exchange archive terms apply.
causal_availability: Funding rate is available at its recorded calc_time. Mark-price bars are not strategy inputs in this audit; the mark open at the exact settlement bar is used only for the contemporaneous funding cashflow. When the official mark archive lacks that exact settlement bar, the exact contract open is used as a disclosed fallback. No forward fill, backfill or future bar is used.
notes: Verified 96 official 2023 fundingRate and markPriceKlines archives across BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT and XRPUSDT.
